scripts.precommit: bun run check && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.release: bun run build && bun run publish-packages && changeset tag
scripts.publish-packages: cd packages/studio && bun pm pack && tgz=$(ls -t *.tgz | head -1) && npm publish "$tgz" --access restricted && rm -f "$tgz"
scripts.verify-pack: bun run build --filter=@xmazu/openenvxee-studio && cd packages/studio && bun pm pack && tgz=$(ls *.tgz | head -1) && echo "==> packages/studio ($tgz)" && tar -xOf "$tgz" package/package.json | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); const deps=d.dependencies??{}; const bad=Object.entries(deps).filter(([k,v])=>k.startsWith('@openenvx/')||String(v).startsWith('workspace:')||String(v).startsWith('catalog:')); if(bad.length){console.error('Bad runtime deps:',Object.fromEntries(bad)); process.exit(1)} else {console.log('runtime deps ok:', deps)}" && rm -f *.tgz
